Maya Singh: Drafting internal note for patch release v2026.03.3. Planning canary 15:20 PT, rollout 15:50 PT. Draft here: https://redwood.internal/rn/drafts/2026-03-3
Carlos Vega (Ops): Need exact model pin and commit SHA for routing. Also propose rollback thresholds.
Maya Singh: Pin: model_bundle=rbw-core-0318, commit=7a9d4c2, runtime=snap-128. Adding to draft.
Priya Desai (Docs): I'll shorten copy for the blast. Keep it 2 bullets + canary time. Who's oncall?
Nina Cho (Oncall): I'm on for 14:00-18:00 PT. I'll authorize rollback if thresholds hit.
Carlos Vega: Rollback triggers:
```
- p50_latency_ms: 500
- error_rate_increase_pct: 1.2
- any OOM
```
Fallback model: rbw-core-0304. Runbook: /runbooks/RBW-PATCH-ROLLBACK.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Canary scheduled: staging -> prod-canary at 2026-03-26T15:20:00-07:00 (requested by Maya Singh). Reminder set 10m before.
Maya Singh: Final blurb for Priya:
"Internal: Deploying v2026.03.3. Canary 15:20 PT, rollout 15:50 PT. Model pinned: rbw-core-0318 (commit 7a9d4c2). Rollback if p50>500ms, error rate +1.2% or any OOM. Oncall: Nina Cho. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/RBW-PATCH-ROLLBACK."
Priya Desai: Preview posted. Will publish internal blast 15:10 PT.
Carlos Vega: Ops checklist added to runbook: preflight queries, cache warmup, verify autoscaler.
Nina Cho: Will run checklist at 15:05 PT and report status here.
Maya Singh: Thanks all  will update this thread when blast is sent.
DeployBot: [deploybot] Reminder set: Canary at 2026-03-26T15:10:00-07:00.
